evidence.section: Required Python version; Splunk product compatibility matrix; Required app
evidence.statement: The versioned Cloud and Enterprise Export prerequisites require Python 3.13 and CIM 8.5.0-1681. The tested table lists Enterprise 10.4.2 and 10.2.2, Cloud 10.5.2605 and 10.4.2604, and ES and SOAR 8.8.0 and 8.7.0 rows. The publisher expressly limits additional Splunkbase listings to upgrades. No row is promoted into broader tested pairing.
